_about: Prose for StudioKIT 2.0 component descriptions. scripts/build-descriptions.mjs combines this with the live property list (figma-properties.json) into docs/figma-descriptions/<slug>.md, which is what gets written to Figma. Button and Input are hand-written in button.md / input.md. `status` (stable · beta · planned) and `code` say whether a component exists in code; `via` names the props that cover a Figma part. Keys starting with `code:` are code components with no generated description.

557:13737.name: Icon Button
557:13737.summary: A button that shows only an icon, for compact, frequently used actions in toolbars, table rows and headers (close, edit, more). Use **Button** when there is room for a label, and **Link Button** to go to another page.
usage: Only use icons people already recognise (close, search, edit, delete, more). If you have to explain the icon, use a Button with a label.
Pair it with a **Tooltip** that names the action.
Match Variant and Style to the Button guidance: Primary for the main action, Secondary + Ghost for most toolbar actions, Danger for destructive ones.
Next to text Buttons, use the same Size so heights line up.
a11y: Give every Icon Button an accessible name with `aria-label` ("Close dialog"), not just the tooltip — without it, screen readers announce an empty button.
XSmall (24px) meets the WCAG 2.5.8 minimum only with spacing around it; on touch screens prefer Medium or Large.
Never remove the `Focus/Base` focus ring.

4402:90631.name: Split Button
4402:90631.summary: A button with a main action plus a menu of related alternatives ("Save" + "Save as draft", "Export as…"). Use **Button** when there is only one action and **Dropdown Menu** when no option is the obvious default.
usage: The main part runs the most common action; the arrow opens a **Dropdown Menu** with the alternatives.
Keep the menu short (2–6 related actions). Don't hide unrelated actions in it.
Follow Button guidance for Variant, Style and Size.
a11y: The arrow is its own button with `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded` and a label such as "More save options".
Both parts must be reachable by keyboard and show a focus ring.

557:15154.name: Link Button
557:15154.summary: A text-only action styled as a link, for navigation or low-emphasis actions inside text, cards and forms ("Forgot your password?", "View all"). Use **Button** for actions that change data.
usage: Use it to go somewhere; use a Button to do something.
Write the destination or result as the label ("View invoice"), never "Click here".
Don't use it as the main action of a form or dialog.
a11y: Render navigation as an `<a href>`, and in-page actions as a `<button>` styled as a link.
Link text must make sense out of context: screen-reader users often list links on their own.

557:9948.name: Accordion
557:9948.summary: A heading that expands and collapses a section of content, for long pages where people only need some sections (FAQs, settings groups, filters). Use **Accordion Group** to stack several, and **Tabs** when sections are peers people switch between.
usage: Write headings that tell people what's inside so they can choose without opening everything.
Don't hide content everyone needs to see, such as errors or required fields.
Start collapsed unless one section is the obvious starting point.
a11y: The heading is a `<button>` inside a heading element, with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` pointing at the panel.
Enter and Space toggle the section.

2746:2110.name: Accordion Group
2746:2110.summary: A stack of **Accordion** items with shared spacing and dividers.
usage: Decide whether several items may be open at once (usually yes) and keep that consistent across the product.
Keep headings parallel in wording and length.
a11y: Each item follows the Accordion pattern; the group needs no extra role.

9711:2016.name: Action Bar
9711:2016.summary: A floating bar of actions that appears when people select items (rows in a table, files, cards) and applies the actions to that selection.
usage: Show the number of selected items and a way to clear the selection.
Keep 2–5 actions; put the rest in a "More" menu.
Hide it as soon as nothing is selected.
a11y: Announce selection changes with a polite live region ("3 items selected").
Make sure keyboard users can move focus to the bar after selecting.

7807:149649.name: Avatar
7807:149649.summary: A picture, initials or icon that represents a person or organisation. Use **Avatar Group** for several people.
usage: Use a photo when you have one, initials when you don't, and the icon as a last resort.
Circles are for people; rounded squares for organisations, teams and workspaces.
The status dot shows presence; don't use it for anything else.
In code, leave `variant` unset: the avatar shows the photo, falls back to initials when the photo fails to load, and to the icon when there is no name. The Figma `Orb` variant is not in code yet.
a11y: If the avatar sits next to the person's name, mark it decorative (`alt=""`); otherwise give it the person's name as alt text.
Don't rely on the status dot's colour alone: also give the status in text or a tooltip.

7807:149985.name: Avatar Group
7807:149985.summary: Overlapping avatars for a set of people (members, assignees), with a "+N" counter when there are more.
usage: Show up to 3–5 avatars, then "+N".
Let people open the full list (popover or dialog) from the counter.
a11y: Give the group a label with the total ("12 members") and make the "+N" counter reachable and named.

9728:22669.name: Breadcrumbs
9728:22669.summary: Shows where the current page sits in the site hierarchy and lets people go back up. Use on pages two or more levels deep; not for a flow of steps (use **Progress Stepper**).
usage: Start at the top level and end with the current page, which isn't a link.
Collapse the middle items into "…" when the trail is long.
Keep labels the same as the page titles they link to.
a11y: Wrap it in `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">` with an ordered list, and set `aria-current="page"` on the last item.
The separators are decorative: hide them from screen readers.

9728:18794.name: Breadcrumb Item
9728:18794.summary: One link in **Breadcrumbs**. Use the Breadcrumbs component in layouts; this is the building block.
usage: Use the current-page style only for the last item.
a11y: Every item except the last is a link.

557:17399.name: Calendar
557:17399.summary: A month grid for picking a date or date range. Usually used inside **Date picker**; place it on its own only when the calendar is the main content.
usage: Make today easy to find and disable dates people can't choose.
Days outside the current month are shown faded; they're decoration, not choices, unless the product needs them.
a11y: Use the grid pattern: arrow keys move by day, Page Up/Down by month, Home/End to the start or end of the week.
Announce the selected date and the visible month; give disabled dates `aria-disabled`.

15489:870.name: Default Card
15489:870.summary: A box that groups related content and actions — a form, a summary, a setting — with optional header and footer. Use **Media Card** when an image leads, **Chart Card** for a chart, and `Container=False` to group content without a box.
usage: Turn Header, Description and Footer on only when you need them.
Put the card's main action in the footer, following Button guidance (one Primary, last in reading order).
Use `Container=False` on grey backgrounds or inside other containers instead of nesting boxes.
Boxed cards use the `Shadow/default` effect and 24px side padding.
a11y: Give the card a real heading when it has a title, one level below the section it sits in. In code, `CardTitle` is an `h2` by default; set `as="h3"` for cards inside a titled section.
If the whole card is clickable, use one link or button inside it and stretch its hit area; don't nest several interactive elements in a clickable card.

15492:1640.name: Media Card
15492:1640.summary: A card led by an image or video (articles, templates, products). Pick the Ratio that matches the media. Use **Default Card** when there's no image.
usage: Crop images to the chosen ratio; don't stretch them.
Keep the title short and put one clear action in the card.
a11y: Give informative images alt text; mark purely decorative images `alt=""`.
Follow Default Card guidance for headings and clickable cards.

15489:18838.name: Chart Card
15489:18838.summary: A card that holds one chart with its title, summary figures and legend, for dashboards.
usage: One chart per card, with a title that says what it shows ("Revenue, last 30 days").
Show the key number in text, not only in the chart.
a11y: Provide the data in text or a table for people who can't see the chart.
Don't rely on colour alone to tell series apart: use labels or patterns too.

15478:19922.name: Kanban Card
15478:19922.summary: A compact card for one item on a board (task, deal, ticket), or a group of them. Use it on board columns, not as a general container.
usage: Show only what people scan for: title, owner, status, date.
Open the full item in a **Side Panel** or page.
a11y: If cards can be dragged, also offer a keyboard or menu way to move them.

557:18425.name: Checkbox
557:18425.summary: Lets people turn a single option on or off, or pick several options from a list. Use **Switch** for settings that take effect immediately and **Radio Button** when only one option can be chosen.
usage: Write labels as positive statements ("Email me updates", not "Don't email me").
Use Indeterminate only for a parent checkbox whose children are partly selected.
Use **Checkbox Group** with a label for a list of options.
Use the Danger type only for high-risk choices ("Delete permanently").
Without a visible label (table row selection, select-all), the checkbox still needs an accessible name.
a11y: Use a native `<input type="checkbox">` with a `<label>`; the whole row, label included, should toggle it.
Standalone checkboxes need an `aria-label` ("Select row Adam Smith", "Select all").
Space toggles it. Use `aria-checked="mixed"` for Indeterminate.

1584:59304.name: Checkbox Group
1584:59304.summary: A labelled list of **Checkbox** options where people can pick any number.
usage: Give the group a visible label and, if needed, helper text.
Order options logically (frequency, alphabetical), and keep the list under about 10; use **Multi Select** for longer lists.
a11y: Wrap it in a `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>`, and link error messages with `aria-describedby`.

557:80335.name: Chip
557:80335.summary: A small interactive element for filters, choices and entered values (filter chips, selected tags in a field). Use **Tag** for read-only labels and **Segmented Control** for switching views.
usage: Filter chips toggle on and off; input chips can be removed with their close icon.
Keep labels to one or two words.
a11y: Toggle chips are buttons with `aria-pressed`; removable chips need a remove button labelled "Remove <value>".

5141:151685.name: Combo Box
5141:151685.summary: A text field with a filtered list of options, for choosing from long lists (countries, people, products) by typing. Use **Single Select** for short lists that don't need search.
usage: Start filtering after the first character and highlight the matching part.
Say clearly whether free text is allowed or a value must be picked from the list.
Show an empty state when nothing matches.
a11y: Follow the ARIA combobox pattern: `role="combobox"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-activedescendant`; arrow keys move through options, Enter selects, Escape closes.
Announce the number of results with a live region.

4209:13875.name: Date picker (Single date)
4209:13875.summary: A field for one date, with a **Calendar** popover. Use **Date picker (Date range)** for start and end dates.
usage: Always allow typing the date as well as picking it; show the expected format.
For dates far in the past (birth dates), typing or separate day/month/year fields work better than a calendar.
a11y: The field follows Input guidance; the calendar button needs a label ("Choose date").
The calendar follows the Calendar keyboard pattern and returns focus to the field when closed.

4209:18675.name: Date picker (Date range)
4209:18675.summary: A field for a start and end date, with a two-month **Calendar** popover and optional preset ranges ("Last 7 days").
usage: Offer presets for common ranges.
Prevent end dates before the start date and explain any limits.
a11y: Label both dates ("Start date", "End date") and announce the selected range.

13101:22726.name: Divider
13101:22726.summary: A thin line that separates groups of content, optionally with a label. Use spacing first; add a divider only when spacing isn't enough.
usage: Don't use dividers between every item in a list or between a heading and its content.
a11y: Decorative dividers need no role; use `<hr>` or `role="separator"` only for a real thematic break.

1490:38985.name: Dropdown Menu
1490:38985.summary: A list of actions or options that opens from a button ("More", user menu, Split Button). Use **Single Select** to choose a value in a form.
usage: Group related items and separate groups with dividers.
Put destructive actions last, in Danger style.
Keep it short; avoid more than one level of submenu.

In code: `DropdownMenuItem` for actions (`variant="danger"` for destructive), `DropdownMenuRadioItem` / `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem` for options, `DropdownMenuLabel` and `DropdownMenuSeparator` for groups. The Search, Select All and Create slots are not in code yet.
a11y: Follow the ARIA menu pattern: the trigger has `aria-haspopup` and `aria-expanded`; arrow keys move, Enter activates, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.

1294:41224.name: Dropdown Menu / Menu Item
1294:41224.summary: One row in a **Dropdown Menu** or **Select** list: label with optional icon, description, shortcut, checkbox or radio.
usage: Start labels with a verb for actions ("Duplicate"); use nouns for options.
Show keyboard shortcuts on the right only if they really work.
a11y: Use `role="menuitem"`, `menuitemcheckbox` or `menuitemradio` to match the item type.

5157:3056.name: File Upload
5157:3056.summary: A field for attaching files, combining a **Dropzone** with the list of uploaded **File** items.
usage: State accepted file types and size limit before people choose a file.
Show progress and allow cancelling or removing each file.
a11y: Keep a real file input (or a button that opens it) so the field works without drag and drop.
Announce upload progress and errors in text.

5155:3828.name: Dropzone
5155:3828.summary: The drag-and-drop area of **File Upload**, with a button to browse files.
usage: Highlight the area while a file is dragged over it.
Always include a "Browse" button for people who can't drag.
a11y: The browse button is the accessible control; the drop area is an enhancement.

557:88402.name: File
557:88402.summary: One uploaded or uploading file in **File Upload**: name, size, progress or status, and actions.
usage: Show errors on the file itself ("Too large — max 10 MB").
a11y: Label actions with the file name ("Remove report.pdf").

557:49476.name: Filter Button
557:49476.summary: A button that opens a filter and shows whether it's active, for table and list toolbars.
usage: Show the active value or count in the button ("Status: Open", "Filters · 2").
Offer a quick way to clear filters.
a11y: Include the active state in the accessible name, and use `aria-expanded` when it opens a popover.

557:51656.name: Form Field
557:51656.via: Input and Select (label, optional, helperText, error props)
557:51656.summary: A complete form field: label, optional "Optional" marker, the control (Input, Text Area, Select, Date picker…), helper text and error message. Use it for every field in a form; pick the control with Type.
usage: Use Vertical orientation by default; Horizontal only in wide settings layouts.
Mark optional fields, not required ones.
Put formatting help in helper text and replace it with the error message when Status is Error; the message should say how to fix the problem.
a11y: Connect the label (`<label for>`), and link helper and error text with `aria-describedby`; set `aria-invalid` on error.
Group checkboxes, radios and date ranges in a `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>`.

4705:88320.name: Inline Alert
4705:88320.summary: A message inside the page, next to the content it's about (a form, a card, a section). Use **System Alert** for app-wide messages and **Toast** for short confirmations.
usage: Pick the status by meaning: info, success, warning or danger.
Lead with what happened, then what to do; include an action if there is one.
Don't stack several alerts in one area; combine them.
a11y: The icon and colour aren't enough on their own: the text must say the status. Each status keeps its own icon shape.
Render the title as a heading that fits the page outline, and give the dismiss button a label ("Dismiss") and at least a 24×24px hit area.
Use `role="alert"` only for urgent messages that appear after an action; otherwise `role="status"` or no role.

9855:38649.name: Modal
9855:38649.summary: A dialog that blocks the page for a focused task or decision (edit an item, confirm a destructive action). Use **Side Panel** when people need to see the page behind it, and **Status Modal** for a single result or confirmation.
usage: Use a clear title, one Primary action, and a Cancel or close.
Keep content short; if it scrolls a lot, use a page or Side Panel instead.
Don't open a modal from another modal.
a11y: Use `role="dialog"` with `aria-modal="true"` and `aria-labelledby` pointing at the title.
Move focus into the modal on open, trap it inside, close on Escape, and return focus to the trigger.

9987:42531.name: Status Modal
9987:42531.summary: A small dialog for a result or confirmation (success, warning, danger) with an icon, message and one or two actions.
usage: For destructive confirmations, name the action in the button ("Delete project"), not "OK".
a11y: For confirmations that need an answer, use `role="alertdialog"`. Otherwise follow Modal guidance.

13058:13975.name: Header
13058:13975.summary: The title area of a **Modal**: title, optional description and close button. Used inside Modal, not on its own.
a11y: The close button needs a label ("Close").

13062:16646.name: Footer
13062:16646.summary: The actions area of a **Modal**. Used inside Modal, not on its own.
usage: Put the Primary action last; use Danger for destructive confirmations.

5321:9464.name: Navigation Bar
5321:9464.summary: The top bar of the app: product logo, main navigation, search and account. Use **Sidebar** when there are many sections.
usage: Keep top-level links to about 5–7.
Highlight the current section.
a11y: Wrap links in `<nav>` with a label, and mark the current link with `aria-current="page"`.
Provide a "Skip to content" link before it.

10785:99185.name: Notifications
10785:99185.summary: A panel listing activity and messages for the user, with read and unread states.
usage: Group by time (Today, Earlier) and let people mark all as read.
Each notification should link to the thing it's about.
a11y: Announce new notifications with a polite live region and show the unread count in the trigger's name.

2646:12655.name: Pagination
2646:12655.summary: Moves through pages of a long list or table. Consider "Load more" or infinite scroll for feeds.
usage: Show the current page and total, plus previous and next.
Keep the page size control near the pagination.
a11y: Wrap it in `<nav aria-label="Pagination">`, label page links ("Page 3"), and set `aria-current="page"`.

10852:61592.name: Pop-up
10852:61592.summary: A small floating panel anchored to a trigger, for extra details or quick actions that don't need a full Modal.
usage: Close it when people click outside or press Escape.
Use **Tooltip** for a short hint and **Dropdown Menu** for a list of actions.
a11y: The trigger needs `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; move focus into the pop-up if it has interactive content.

4716:92306.name: Progress Bar
4716:92306.summary: Shows how far a task has got (upload, setup, quota). Use a spinner when progress can't be measured.
usage: Show the value as text too ("60%", "3 of 5 steps").
a11y: Use `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and a label.

10034:31374.name: Progress Stepper
10034:31374.summary: Shows the steps of a multi-step flow (checkout, onboarding) and where people are. Use **Breadcrumbs** for site hierarchy.
usage: Keep to 3–7 steps with short labels.
Show completed, current and upcoming states; let people go back to completed steps.
a11y: Use an ordered list and mark the current step with `aria-current="step"`; include the state in text ("Completed").

2642:14283.name: Progress Tracker
2642:14283.summary: A segmented bar that shows progress through a fixed number of stages (for example a status pipeline).
usage: Label the stages or show the current stage in text.
a11y: Give it a text equivalent such as "Stage 2 of 4: In review".

557:58107.name: Radio Button
557:58107.summary: Lets people pick exactly one option from a short list. Use **Radio Group** to lay them out, **Single Select** for more than about 5 options, and **Checkbox** when several can be chosen.
usage: Preselect a sensible default unless choosing nothing is valid.
Keep labels short and parallel.
a11y: Use native radios with the same `name`; arrow keys move between options.

1584:59135.name: Radio Group
1584:59135.summary: A labelled set of **Radio Button** options where exactly one can be chosen.
usage: Give the group a visible label and order options logically.
a11y: Wrap it in a `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>`; link errors with `aria-describedby`.

9986:109308.name: Search
9986:109308.summary: A field for searching content, with a search icon and optional clear button and shortcut hint.
usage: Use placeholder text that says what's searchable ("Search projects").
Show results as people type when that's fast; otherwise on Enter.
a11y: Use `role="search"` on the surrounding form and give the field a label (it can be visually hidden).
Label the clear button ("Clear search").

557:61066.name: Segmented Control
557:61066.summary: A row of 2–5 mutually exclusive options for switching views or modes (List / Grid, Day / Week / Month). Use **Tabs** for switching between sections of content and **Radio Group** in forms.
usage: Keep labels short and similar in length; icons need tooltips.
The change should apply immediately.
a11y: Use a radio group (`role="radiogroup"`) or toggle buttons with `aria-pressed`; arrow keys move the selection.

1862:10385.name: Single Select
1862:10385.summary: Lets people choose one value from a list in a form. Use **Combo Box** for long lists that need search, **Radio Group** for up to about 5 visible options, and **Dropdown Menu** for actions.
usage: Use a placeholder like "Select a country" only when there's no sensible default.
Order options logically.
a11y: Prefer a native `<select>` where possible; custom selects must follow the ARIA listbox or combobox pattern.

1902:4145.name: Multi Select
1902:4145.summary: Lets people choose several values from a list; selections show as chips in the field. Use **Checkbox Group** when all options fit on screen.
usage: Let people remove a selection from the field directly.
Add search when the list is long.
a11y: Follow the listbox pattern with `aria-multiselectable="true"`; each chip's remove button needs a label.

5240:20822.name: Sidebar
5240:20822.summary: The main side navigation of the app, with sections, items and optional collapse. Use **Navigation Bar** when there are only a few top-level sections.
usage: Group items under short section labels; highlight the current page.
Collapsed state shows icons with tooltips.
a11y: Wrap it in `<nav>` with a label and mark the current item with `aria-current="page"`.
The collapse button needs `aria-expanded` and a label.

557:76753.name: Side Panel
557:76753.summary: A panel that slides in from the side for details or editing while keeping the page visible. Use **Modal** when the task must block the page.
usage: Use it for item details, filters and secondary editing.
Give it a clear title and a close button.
a11y: If it blocks the page, follow Modal focus rules; if not, use `role="complementary"` or `region` with a label and move focus to it on open.

557:71428.name: Slider
557:71428.summary: Picks a value or range by dragging along a track (volume, price range). Use an **Input** when people need an exact value.
usage: Show the current value, and add an input next to it for precise entry when it matters.
a11y: Use `role="slider"` (or native range input) with value attributes and a label; arrow keys change the value, Page Up/Down in bigger steps.

10590:65508.name: Spreadsheet Column
10590:65508.summary: A column of editable **Spreadsheet Cell** items with a header, for grid-style data editing.
usage: Use for editing many values in place; use **Table** for read-mostly data.
a11y: Follow the ARIA grid pattern: arrow keys move between cells, Enter edits, Escape cancels.

10590:65934.name: Spreadsheet Cell
10590:65934.summary: One editable cell of a spreadsheet: text, number, select, date and other types.
usage: Show validation errors on the cell itself.
a11y: Each cell is a `gridcell`; the editing control inside follows its own component's guidance.

557:10806.name: Status Badge
557:10806.summary: A small label that shows the status of an item (Active, Pending, Failed). Use **Tag** for categories and **Chip** for interactive filters.
usage: Use a small, consistent set of statuses across the product.
Pick the colour by meaning (positive, notice, negative, info, neutral).
a11y: Status must be readable as text; never use colour or the icon alone.

557:75442.name: Switch
557:75442.summary: Turns a single setting on or off, taking effect immediately. Use **Checkbox** in forms that are submitted.
usage: Label the setting, not the state ("Email notifications", not "On").
Put the label before the switch and keep the effect immediate; show a confirmation if it's important.
a11y: Use `role="switch"` with `aria-checked` (or a native checkbox styled as a switch); Space toggles it.

557:55446.name: System Alert
557:55446.summary: A full-width banner for messages about the whole app or account (maintenance, billing, outage). Use **Inline Alert** for messages about one part of the page.
usage: Show only one at a time and let people dismiss it unless it's critical.
Say what happened and what to do.
a11y: Use `role="status"` for informational messages and `role="alert"` only for urgent ones; don't rely on colour alone.

9234:85146.name: Column
9234:85146.summary: A table column with its header and **Table Cell** items, for building tables of structured data.
usage: Left-align text and right-align numbers.
Let people sort columns where it's useful and show the sort direction.
a11y: Use real `<table>` markup with `<th scope="col">`; sortable headers are buttons with `aria-sort`.

9233:69190.name: Column Divider
9233:69190.summary: The vertical line between table columns. The Freeze types mark the edge of frozen (sticky) columns, with a shadow while the table scrolls. Used inside **Column**, not on its own.
usage: Use `Freeze` after the last frozen column and `Freeze (Scrolling)` once the content scrolls under it.

9233:69238.name: Table Cell
9233:69238.summary: One cell of a table: text, number, badge, avatar, actions and other content types.
usage: Keep one kind of content per column and truncate long text with a tooltip.
a11y: Row actions need labels that include the row ("Edit Adam Smith").

2014:13749.name: Tabs
2014:13749.summary: Switches between related sections of content on the same page. Use **Segmented Control** to switch views of the same content and **Sidebar** or **Navigation Bar** to go to other pages.
usage: Keep labels short (one or two words) and the number of tabs small.
Don't use tabs for steps in a sequence (use **Progress Stepper**).
a11y: Follow the ARIA tabs pattern: `role="tablist"`, `tab` and `tabpanel` with `aria-selected`; arrow keys move between tabs.

831:14706.name: Tag
831:14706.summary: A small read-only label for categories and metadata (project type, team, topic). Use **Status Badge** for states and **Chip** for interactive filters or values.
usage: Use colours for categories only; they don't carry meaning like success or danger.
Keep labels short.
a11y: The text must stand on its own; colour is decoration.

557:82344.name: Text Area
557:82344.summary: A multi-line field for longer free text (comments, descriptions), with an optional formatting bar. Use **Input** for single-line values.
usage: Size it to the expected length and let it grow or scroll.
Show a character count when there's a limit.
a11y: Follow Input guidance for labels, helper text and errors; announce character-limit warnings.

9657:159805.name: Select Tile
9657:159805.summary: A large selectable card for choosing between a few options that need more explanation (plans, templates, account types). Use **Radio Group** or **Checkbox Group** for simple options.
usage: Keep tiles the same size and structure so they're easy to compare.
a11y: Build tiles as radios or checkboxes (or `role="radio"`) so selection is announced; the whole tile is the label.

557:85743.name: Action Tile
557:85743.summary: A large clickable tile that starts an action or goes somewhere ("Create project", "Import data").
usage: Use for a small set of starting points, not as general navigation.
a11y: Make the tile one link or button with a clear name; don't nest other controls inside.

4705:89222.name: Toast
4705:89222.summary: A short, temporary message after an action ("Saved", "Message sent"), optionally with Undo. Use **Inline Alert** for messages people must read or act on.
usage: Keep it to one line; add one action at most (Undo, View).
Don't use toasts for errors that need fixing.
a11y: Announce with a polite live region (`role="status"`).
Keep it visible long enough to read (at least 5 seconds), pause on hover and focus, and make any action reachable by keyboard.

557:88017.name: Tooltip
557:88017.summary: A short text hint shown on hover and focus, for icon-only buttons and truncated text. Use **Pop-up** for anything interactive or longer than a sentence.
usage: Keep it to a few words; never put essential information only in a tooltip.
a11y: Show it on keyboard focus as well as hover, link it with `aria-describedby`, and let Escape dismiss it.
Don't put links or buttons inside a tooltip.

1699:2520.name: Entity
1699:2520.summary: A building block that shows a person or object with an avatar or thumbnail, title and secondary text, used in lists, tables and menus.
usage: Keep the secondary line short and useful (email, role, size).

1902:22669.name: Helper Text
1902:22669.summary: The text under a field for hints, warnings and error messages. Used inside **Form Field**.
usage: Errors say how to fix the problem ("Enter a date after today").
a11y: Link it to the field with `aria-describedby`.

4803:158547.name: Field Label
4803:158547.summary: The label above a field, with optional "Optional" marker and info icon. Used inside **Form Field**.
usage: Use short noun phrases ("Email address").
a11y: Must be a real `<label>` connected to its field.

1699:21315.name: Prefix
1699:21315.summary: Content at the start of a field (icon, text, country code, small button). Used inside Input, Search and Select.
a11y: Text prefixes ("$", "https://") should be part of the field's accessible name or description.

1699:36894.name: Suffix
1699:36894.summary: Content at the end of a field (unit, icon, clear or show-password button). Used inside Input, Search and Select.
a11y: Buttons in the suffix need labels ("Clear", "Show password").

938:36926.name: Thumbnail
938:36926.summary: A small preview of a file or media item by type (PDF, image, video, document).
usage: Use the real preview when available; the type icon otherwise.
a11y: Decorative when the file name is shown next to it.

938:37191.name: Shortcut
938:37191.summary: Shows a keyboard shortcut (⌘ K) in menus, tooltips and search.
usage: Only show shortcuts that work, and use the right modifier keys for the platform.
a11y: Expose shortcuts with `aria-keyshortcuts` on the control they trigger.
